=== search all npm/pnpm config locations ===
--- /root/.npmrc:
--- /workspace/.npmrc:
--- /workspace/app/.npmrc:
strict-peer-dependencies=false
auto-install-peers=true
engine-strict=true
use-node-version = 24.16.0
prefer-workspace-packages=true

@sw-code:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com
--- /etc/npmrc:
=== env ===

observation.command: cd /workspace/app && pnpm config get minimumReleaseAge 2>&1; echo "=== search all npm/pnpm config locations ==="; for f in ~/.npmrc /workspace/.npmrc /workspace/app/.npmrc /etc/npmrc; do echo "--- $f:"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null; done; echo "=== env ==="; env | grep -iE "npm_config|pnpm|release" | head
